title: Binary Sparse Codes: Where are we on Energy Efficient Representations?
abstract: arXiv:2610.41933v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Biological neural systems achieve impressive computational capabilities under tight metabolic constraints, relying on sparse cortical representations that minimise total neural activity. This combination of efficiency and representational power has motivated growing interest in sparse coding as a computational strategy for artificial systems. Artificial models designed to produce binary sparse codes span three broad paradigms, theoretical methods grounded in efficient coding, deep learning methods trained via backpropagation, and biologically plausible methods that learn through local Hebbian rules, each yielding codes whose quality depends not only on achieving low activation density but also on preserving the informational structure of the input. translated_title: 二元稀疏编码：在高效节能表征方面我们走到了哪里？
translated_abstract: 生物神经系统在严苛的代谢约束下展现出令人惊叹的计算能力，这依赖于稀疏的皮层表征来最小化总的神经活动。这种效率与表征能力的结合，激发了人们对将稀疏编码作为人工系统计算策略的日益浓厚的兴趣。旨在产生二元稀疏码的人工模型涵盖三大范式：基于高效编码理论的理论方法、通过反向传播训练的深度学习方法，以及通过局部Hebbian规则学习的生物学合理方法。每种方法所产生的编码质量不仅取决于能否实现低激活密度，还取决于能否保留输入的信息结构。然而，后一性质缺乏公认的定量定义，导致该领域缺少一个有原则的方法比较基础。我们提出了一套指标来形式化信息……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文系统梳理了产生二元稀疏码的三大范式（理论方法、深度学习方法与生物合理性方法），并针对“信息结构保持”缺乏统一定义的问题提出了一套量化指标，为不同稀疏编码方法的原则性比较奠定了基础。
en_tdlr: This paper surveys three paradigms for producing binary sparse codes—theoretical, deep learning, and biologically plausible methods—and proposes a set of metrics to formally quantify information structure preservation, establishing a principled basis for comparing sparse coding approaches.
